title: FiniteEtaleYonedaLocalTrivializations
statement: Let $T$ and $P$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $\pi:P\to T$ finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Let $h_P$ be its canonical sheaf of sections on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets], with values raised to the universe of sets used in the library. There is an etale cover $\{U_i\to T\}$ and, for each $i$, a finite set $S_i$ and an isomorphism $h_P|_{U_i}\cong\underline{S_i}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Moreover the stalk of $h_P$ at every separably closed geometric point of $T$ is finite, equivalently $h_P$ satisfies Scheme.IsFiniteSheaf.

proof.text: Choose the pointed etale neighbourhood and finite coproduct splitting supplied by finite_etale_etale_local_split at each point of T. Cover.mkOfCovers forms the jointly surjective etale cover from these choices. Replace each summand by its given isomorphism with the base, using Sigma.mapIso and the cofan colimit, to obtain an isomorphism from the coproduct of copies to the pullback, compatible with its second projection.

For an etale neighbourhood U, construct a natural isomorphism between the restriction of h_P, transported to U.left.smallEtaleTopology by Etale.overSheafEquiv, and constantSetCoproductPresheaf U.left J. A section a over T is sent to pullback.lift a W.hom followed by the inverse coproduct splitting; the inverse composes with the splitting and pullback.fst. The pullback projection equations prove both inverse laws and naturality. Apply constantSheaf_sets_representable and constantSheafSheafCongrIso, then use full faithfulness of the site equivalence to obtain the local model on the localized site. Its value is ULift J, which is finite, including J empty.

For a separably closed geometric point s, use Cover.exists_eq and exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed to choose a lift to a cover member U. For the site point Phi = pointSmallEtale s and its chosen element a at U, the category of elements of Phi.over a is equivalent to Over (Phi.fiber.elementsMk U a), by Mathlib fromOverFunctorElementsEquivalence. Over.initial_forget and Functor.Final.colimitIso identify the stalk of F.over U with the stalk of F. Lift the site point to the coefficient universe using uliftSheafFiberIso and apply the local sheaf isomorphism and sheafFiberConstantSheafIso. This identifies the original stalk with the finite local value. Convert finiteness to finite generation with ConcreteCategory.isFinitelyGenerated_iff_finite, obtaining IsFiniteSheaf. All glue is proved in private helpers, with no new sorry.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteEtale_yoneda_local_trivializations
    (T P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ T) [IsFinite π] [Etale π] :
    (∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧
        Nonempty (((T.smallEtaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}).obj (Etale.mk π)).over
            (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i) ≅
          (constantSheaf (T.smallEtaleTopology.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i))
            (Type (u + 1))).obj S)) ∧
    IsFiniteSheaf ((T.smallEtaleTopology.uliftYoneda.{u + 1}).obj (Etale.mk π))
